Since other bidders have unknown values between $0-$49, I want to bid strategically. A bid slightly below my true value ($29-$30) protects against overpaying while still giving a good chance of winning. I'll aim to bid $29.9 to maximize potential profit, balancing winning probability with minimizing potential loss.
